description:
Tucked away South of the Blvd in Tarzana, this iconic single-story mid-century modern by renowned architect Charles Du Bois sits on an expansive 11,000+ sq. ft. lot and effortlessly blends timeless design with modern comfort.
Double doors open to a thoughtfully designed floor plan, where a spacious living room anchored by a stone fireplace creates a warm and inviting focal point. The beautifully remodeled kitchen features high-end stainless steel appliances and flows seamlessly into a formal dining room, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.
The home offers four generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a spa-inspired bathroom complete with a soaking tub, rainfall shower, and double vanity. Multiple sliding glass doors lead to a covered patio, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience.
The private backyard is highlighted by a large grassy yard surrounded by lush, mature landscaping, offering both space and privacy. Additional features include vaulted ceilings throughout, a state-of-the-art home theater, and a two-car garage.
